reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Mark Wilson
reviews.text: Dustin just installed a whole house standby generator. We are very pleased with the installation and look forward to many years of excellent service. Thanks.

reviews.author: Chad LIbecap
reviews.text: Parker’s electric is the most reliable electrical service you will find in the area. I own multiple rental properties and I’ve used Parker’s electric for many years. They are very responsive, fair pricing, and they will not try and upsell you on anything. Highly recommend them for any project or problem.

reviews.author: Joey Toler
reviews.text: My son introduced me to Dustin when I needed an electrician. Dustin and his crew came over and handled all my electrical issues and I couldn’t be more pleased! Great team! Very professional and friendly!

reviews.author: Wayne Smith
reviews.text: Dustin and his crew solved a puzzling problem i had with an outdoor light. I could never figure it out. They also replaced an old motion sensor light. Excellent job guys. They also have serviced my Generac generator twice. Of all the work they have done I am very pleased. They are very thorough in what they did. Price is very reasonable and affordable. Thank you Dustin

reviews.author: Phillip Warren
reviews.text: Dustin and his crew installed a home generator for us recently. The work was done promptly and happened just as Dustin said it would. We couldn’t be more pleased with the finished product. Parker’s Electric has been and will continue to be our choice for electric services.

reviews.author: B Smith
reviews.text: Highly recommend Dustin and his guys for electrical and generator installation. They were easy to work with and made sure everything was installed and ready to go in one day. Dustin even had a personal contact with a gas company and arranged for new gas service at my home and arranged for them to be there the same day he was to complete their work.

reviews.author: Lisa Hatfield
reviews.text: I have worked with Parker's Electrical on 2 separate occasions to have generators installed. The work is excellent. Dustin coordinated the various agencies involved so that installation went smoothly. He communicated with us at each step so we knew what to expect. Highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: Dennis Moore
reviews.text: Dustin and his team are the BEST! they just put in a generator for us great job. Very impressive! Give Dustin a call for your next electric project..

reviews.author: Louis High
reviews.text: Called Dustin at night after hours when I was having a major issue with my Generac transfer switch. He answered immediately and arrived at my home in a matter of minutes to assist. He's always willing to answer any Generac and electrical questions and provides thorough service.

reviews.author: Papabear Santa
reviews.text: Called them several times. He did send 2 guys to look at my fuse box and told me it needed replacement. I waited about a week, and I never heard from him and he never gave me an estimate. When i did call him, all he said was he was working on generates . If you're looking for someone to do work in your home, do not call him

reviews.author: michael doyle
reviews.text: Generac generator installation. Parker’s knew their role as well as the propane company’s role. Was able to offer cost saving recommendations, work around propane company’s schedule, and ensure our power will not be limited by the next unexpected (at least twice a year) power outage. Great electrician. Highly qualified and well recommended.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Wall
reviews.text: Parker’s really helped me and my family out when we had an emergency, he did not hesitate to come out and help us and go the extra mile for us! I highly recommend them for any electrical work that you need done!

reviews.author: Joshua Holman
reviews.text: The guys at Parkers Electric are phenomenal to say the least. The work they've done has been awesome. They kept there work area clean and tidy throughout the entire job and after everything was installed amd in place they went and double checked everything. Staff were very friendly and full of advice and had an answer for all of my questions, I was nervous to ask at first but they made me comfotable enough to ask questions. Instead of looking at me like I was dumb they gave me excellent answers that I understood perfectly and even walked me through some of the processes. They deserve a 10. I really enjoyed working with these guys amd I recommend then for any electrical issues that.may arise at home. May GOD bless!

reviews.author: Quality Landscapes
reviews.text: Great customer service! Extremely fast response time. They explained everything and made sure we were taken care of! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Carl Wullenwaber
reviews.text: Dustin & his employees are great! Very helpful and knowledgeable. Great pricing as well. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Zachery Lewis
reviews.text: Excellent service!!! They came out and had everything back in working order in less than an hour and very reasonably priced! Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Marie Price
reviews.text: Dustin was very informative, explained things very well. He was quick to respond did a nice job on our outside outlet. It was a small job but he made it a priority to come check it out. Recommend him to ANYONE!!
